records.statement: Cash custody: ideal cashier float Rp300,000; at shift close, cash physically remaining at the cashier may be up to Rp2,000,000 maximum; excess must be deposited to Bank BRI or held by Aidit. The legacy Rp30,000 shift-variance tolerance is explicitly not current.

Legacy escort threshold (Rp5,000,000) was not addressed by the owner and is neither reaffirmed nor rejected.

records.statement: A legacy rule implying sugar retail must be packaged at <=1kg must NOT be ported into SJS as an active business rule. The business sells sugar by weight (kiloan), not necessarily pre-packaged retail sugar; the legacy characterization may not fit the actual business model.
records.notes: Genuine, unresolved evidentiary discrepancy: this reconciliation's own earlier second-hand paraphrase (Permendag 1/2019 jo. 17/2022 blocking retail sale of Gula Kristal Rafinasi) does not exactly match the owner's own framing (a packaging-size rule). Neither forensic pass read the original source document directly. The do-not-port decision holds regardless of which characterization is correct.
